Metadata.title: SecureCargo — Physics-tested cargo securement
Metadata.description: Check before the trip whether a truck's cargo is well distributed and properly secured: photo, physics simulation and a lashing plan that follows Brazilian rules.

hero.title: Physics-tested cargo securement.
hero.subtitle: Simulate the trip before the truck leaves.

posterAlt.unsecured: A flatbed truck carrying three wooden crates with no straps.
posterAlt.secured: A flatbed truck carrying three wooden crates held down by amber straps.

captions.unsecured: Unsecured: under hard braking, the cargo slides forward into the headboard.
captions.secured: Secured: the same braking, and the straps hold the cargo in place.

problem.label: Problem
problem.title: A load is checked with a look and a pull on the strap.
problem.p1: Before a trip, the driver walks around the truck, tugs each strap and decides it is good enough. Nothing in that check says what the cargo will do in a hard stop, a tight curve or a pothole.
problem.p2: Brazil has detailed rules for lashing cargo and for the weight each axle may carry. They are legal text. On the loading dock, what is needed is a yes or a no for this cargo on this truck.
problem.p3: SecureCargo runs the trip before the truck leaves. It builds the load from a photo, drives it through braking, curves and potholes in a physics simulation, and shows what moves, why, and the smallest change that fixes it.

how.label: How it works
how.title: From a photo to a tested plan.

photo.title: Photo
photo.body: Take a photo of the loaded truck bed. There are no forms to fill in first.

perceive.title: Perceive
perceive.body: AI marks the cargo units and the straps it sees. You confirm them, or fix what it got wrong.

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.body: A physics engine drives the load through hard braking, curves and potholes, and records what slides or tips.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: You see where each unit should sit and how many straps go where, checked against Brazilian rules and against every simulated event.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.body: A shareable record of the photo, the plan and the simulation result, for the carrier and the insurer.

demo.label: Demo
demo.title: Four loads, four ways it can go wrong.

braking.title: Emergency braking
braking.body: A hard stop with loose crates. See what reaches the headboard.

weighStation.title: Weigh station
weighStation.body: The cargo fits on the bed, but the weight sits on the wrong axle.

rope.title: Rope lashing
rope.body: A load tied with rope instead of straps, tested under braking.

curve.title: Sharp curve
curve.body: A tall unit, a tight curve and not enough lashing.
